title: Capstone finish, mock loop, consolidation
objectives: Finish and present the capstone, simulate a full interview loop, and lock in long-term retention.
exercise: Days 1–3: finish the capstone, write a README (recommendation → evals → experiment plan), and record a 5-minute walkthrough. Days 4–5: full mock loop: SQL 45m, stats/experimentation 45m, product case 45m, ML system design 45m, behavioral 30m, scored against a rubric. Day 6: re-queue units behind every gap. Day 7: final spaced-repetition sweep.
resources: Checkpoint results in this app (Stats → weakest units)

Explain your capstone architecture in 60 seconds.
cards.answer: Personal answer. A strong version covers: ingestion and chunking of the policy docs → hybrid retrieval (BM25 + dense) → reranker → LLM with citations → one tool via MCP → tracing → eval suite (assertions + validated judge) in CI → launch experiment (unit, primary metric, guardrails, CUPED, GST, DiD fallback) → monitoring.
rubric: Evals and how the judge was validated
How launch impact will be measured

cards.q: An interviewer asks how you'd know the assistant is getting worse in production. Answer?

cards.q: Why expose the fee calculator as a tool instead of letting the LLM compute fees?
